title: Human Physiology IV (DDS2111/DMP2104): Main Exam, Thur 26th March, 2026 11.00am
programme: Diploma in Community Oral Health / diploma in Dental Technology

items.text: SECTION A: SHORT ANSWER ESSAY QUESTIONS
Answer ALL questions. Each question carries 6 Marks.
Outline the roles of melanin and keratin in the skin.
State the structural organization of the skin, naming its major layers and one function of each.
Outline six functions of the skin that contribute to maintaining normal body physiology.
State six differences between normal body temperature and fever in terms of physiological regulation.
Identify six types of general sensory receptors and state the stimulus detected by each.
SECTION B: LONG ANSWER ESSAY QUESTIONS
Answer Question ONE and any other ONE question. (Each question carries 20 Marks.)
Discuss the physiology of body temperature regulation and the clinical consequences of abnormal temperature states. In your answer:

parts.text: Explain how heat is produced in the human body.

items.text: Discuss the physiology of body temperature regulation and the clinical consequences of abnormal temperature states. In your answer:

parts.text: Describe the mechanisms by which heat is lost.
Discuss the clinical consequences of fever, hypothermia, and hyperthermia

items.text: Explain the physiology of the visual and auditory systems. In your answer:

parts.text: Describe the visual pathway from the retina to the visual cortex.
Explain the role of the cochlea in hearing.

items.text: Describe the physiology of taste, smell, and oral sensation. In your answer:

parts.text: Explain the physiology of taste and smell.
Discuss the role of oral sensory receptors (pain, temperature, pressure, tooth sensation) in oral health practice.
